title: Validation
subtitle: Field validators and resolvers
description: Configure when and how form validation runs.
content: Validation runs on `save` / `validate`, and optionally on change or blur via `validate.on`.

sections.title: Modes
sections.content:
- `change` — after each `set`
- `blur` — after `touch`
- `submit` — during `save` / `validate` (default-ish for save path)
- `manual` — only when you call `validate*` explicitly

sections.title: Field validators
sections.content: Keys support wildcards (`contacts.*.email`). Return a string message or null/undefined when valid:

sections.title: Schema resolver
sections.content: Use `zodResolver` or any function returning a flat path → message map. See [zodResolver](/form/docs/zodResolver).
